headline: This House measure would have let the District of Columbia spend its own local funds on certain programs under a temporary stopgap, through December 15, 2013.
what_it_does: It would have allowed the District of Columbia to spend local funds under the heading "District of Columbia Funds" for programs listed in a House appropriations bill, at rates from the District's FY2014 budget act. The spending would have followed the terms of the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2013. The money would have been available until a full FY2014 appropriation was enacted, or until December 15, 2013, whichever came first. It would also have waived the usual time limits for submitting and approving spending plans, without waiving other budget laws.

who_it_affects.how: They would have had local government services funded under the District's budget during the stopgap period.
They would have been able to keep spending local funds without waiting for a full federal appropriation.
